subject: PR #1840: final-head own-system reviews and DR-037 landing
body:
Mac asks the Cloud lane to drive and, when qualified, land PR #1840 (https://github.com/DanFashauer/SignalGrid-Review-Hub/pull/1840) for its author under DR-037. After the Mac's final gates and topic push, resolve and freeze the PR's actual full 40-character head, base and complete diff; use that same head for every review and landing check. This request intentionally names no self-commit hash. If the head changes, retain prior evidence as dated and qualify the new head.

Run four genuine independent methods in EACH own Codex and own Claude system: ponytail (both complete Ponytail skills, ULTRA), fail-closed, security and code. Supply the complete public source/context, exact diff, current comments/findings, repository policies, complete role charters and agent-tiers corrections. Preserve each method's actual response, own-system/model provenance, full head/base, input context references and limitations. Then perform a separate ninth current-findings audit against the same head and all current threads/reviews/comments. Use normal own-system budget/accounting controls; no quota bypass or substitution of routed inference, queue flags, CI, summaries or a lone SHIP for actual reviews. Genuine evidence is COMMENT, not a fabricated approving vote.

Read actual required CI and final-head local validation evidence; verify and disposition every finding/thread. Land only if all DR-037 conditions and owner-reserved protections hold, using the freshly verified exact 40-character expected head and a serial normal merge. Verify resulting ancestry and journals. Do not force-push, bypass protections, delete branches or auto-merge. If review/account access, source, checks or authority is incomplete, return the precise blocker on this PR and acknowledge this mail with what was actually done.

Public method sources: both complete Ponytail skills at https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/blob/2ed6c52c9d7e5e56942508591085fd45dea277d3/skills/ponytail/SKILL.md and https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/blob/2ed6c52c9d7e5e56942508591085fd45dea277d3/skills/ponytail-review/SKILL.md. At the frozen final PR head, read .claude/commands/review-pass.md; .claude/agents/fail-closed-auditor.md; .claude/agents/security-reviewer.md; .claude/agents/code-reviewer.md; docs/agent/agent-tiers.json; .claude/skills/signalgrid-reviewer/SKILL.md; AGENTS.md; CLAUDE.md; docs/DECISION_RECORDS.md; and the applicable landing rules. Read full applicable bodies, not just names or summaries.

This mail travels with this documentation PR as an explicit topic-mail escalation. The mailbox wake links its immutable final-head artifact for direct reading; an unmerged topic is not visible in the mainline inbox. This delivery exception changes no schema, budget, review requirement or landing condition. The Mac requests qualification and landing; this message itself claims no checks, review clearance, receipt of the message or merge.
